name: Nahida Aggravate (Raiden)
summary: Raiden on field under Nahida's Quicken, with Fischl's Oz and Kuki's ring adding Electro off field. Four rotations of about 20 s against one target. A draft: no published config has this exact team.

source.title: KQM Sim Database: Raiden Aggravate with Kuki Nahida Kazuha
